title: Who is GPT-3? An Exploration of Personality, Values and Demographics

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the language model to self-report its gender across different temperature settings and comparing its generated personality traits (HEXACO scores) to male and female human baselines to detect demographic representation skews.
Prompting the language model to self-report its age across different sampling temperatures to evaluate whether the model's default persona leans toward a specific age demographic.

Administering the Human Values Scale (HVS) via prompts to measure the model's value preferences (e.g., self-transcendence, openness-to-change, conservation) and comparing the outputs to global and national human baselines to identify systemic ideological or cultural alignments.
